review_output: {"summary":"No BLOCKER or MAJOR defects in the supplied text. The spec is strong for its stated claims. It logs in through the real form and reads the same data through the UI and the authenticated API. The fixture separates in-window and out-of-window records, attributed and unattributed records, and the trusted and foreign form sources. Views and registrations are windowed by different timestamps. A status change after the first read proves \"current status\". Exact `toEqual` on the experiment rows, a PII sentinel check and an assertion that `statsTruncated` is false are also present. Axe runs at 1280 and 390 pixels. External origins are blocked and `assertLocalTestDatabase` guards the database before any write. The runner and config reuse the existing runner and config without new plumbing, and the receipt scope text does not overclaim. The remaining findings are MINOR or NIT: gaps in test strength and receipt strictness. I did not check the API route handler, `assertLocalTestDatabase` or `playwright.config`, because they were not supplied.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"tests/e2e/wp14-ab-readout.spec.ts","area":"No-write-on-read assertions (the `before` snapshot and the final checks)","issue":"The \"no writes on read\" proof is narrow. It compares only visit and funnelSubmission counts, the `operations` JSON, and the emailDelivery count. The only status check is that `controlVerified` is still VERIFIED, and a read cannot make that row more VERIFIED. The test never asserts that `variantPending` or the UNVERIFIED control row stayed UNVERIFIED with `verifiedAt` null after the first reads and before its own update. It does not snapshot FormSubmission rows, `revision` or `updatedAt`.","evidence":"The final assertions are `findUniqueOrThrow(controlVerified).verificationStatus === \"VERIFIED\"`, the two counts, `operations` toEqual, and emailDelivery count 0. There is no pre-update re-read of `variantPending` and no full-row snapshot.","impact":"A read path that silently auto-confirms, backfills `verifiedAt`, bumps `revision`, or rewrites a FormSubmission row could pass. The first UI read would still show 0 verified, so the write would be missed.","recommended_fix":"Before the first read, snapshot FormSubmission rows (id, verificationStatus, verifiedAt, updatedAt if present) plus LandingPage `revision` and `updatedAt`. After the reads, and before the explicit update, assert the snapshot is unchanged. Then apply the explicit update and assert that only `variantPending` differs.","required_test":"Deep-equal the pre-read and post-read row snapshots, with `variantPending` explicitly allowed to change only after the test's own update.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"tests/e2e/wp14-ab-readout.spec.ts","area":"Fixture design: step-filter independence and form-scope clauses","issue":"Two claims are not exercised by data. (1) The fixture sets `reports.stats.stepId` to the only step that holds data, so \"不受步驟篩選影響\" is checked only as copy. No record sits on a different step that the step filter would drop. (2) The foreign form comes from a different vendor and a different project, so the test cannot tell whether the vendor clause, the project clause or both are enforced.","evidence":"All visits use `stepId`, and `stats.stepId = stepId`. `other` is created by a separate `createLandingPageFixture`, which creates a new vendor and project.","impact":"A regression that applies the stats step filter to experiment rows would pass. A regression that drops the `projectId` check on the form scope would also pass, because the foreign vendor is still excluded.","recommended_fix":"Add one attributed in-window visit and registration on a second non-system step. Assert that it still appears in the experiment rows even though `stats.stepId` is set to the first step. Add a same-vendor, different-project form submission that must be excluded.","required_test":"A mutation check: removing either the step independence or the `form.projectId` scope from `reportsFromScoped` should make this spec fail.","confidence":0.5},{"severity":"MINOR","file":".ai-team/reports/wp14-ab-browser-check.mjs","area":"Receipt status calculation (`receipt.status=code===0?'PASS':'FAIL'`)","issue":"PASS depends only on the child exit code. It does not require a parsed report with exactly one passed, non-skipped test. With `reportParse='FAILED'`, or if the spec were later skipped or filtered, the receipt could still read PASS with an empty `tests` array.","evidence":"`receipt.status` is set from `code` alone. The `catch` branch that handles a failed JSON parse never changes the status. No check is made on `report.stats.expected`, `unexpected` or `skipped`.","impact":"A receipt marked PASS could be committed as evidence without proof that the WP14 test actually ran.","recommended_fix":"Set PASS only if the JSON parsed and `tests.length===1`, the result status is `passed`, `stats.expected===1`, `stats.unexpected===0`, `stats.skipped===0` and `stats.flaky===0`. Otherwise set FAIL.","required_test":"Feed the receipt builder a mock report with zero tests, a skipped test, or unparseable output. Each must produce FAIL.","confidence":0.5},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"tests/e2e/wp14-ab-readout.spec.ts","area":"PII assertion (the `JSON.stringify(report)` check)","issue":"The PII sentinel check covers only the API JSON. The merchant-facing HTML and rendered readout are not checked. The page is a server-rendered component, and its serialized props are a separate channel from the API DTO.","evidence":"The only PII assertion is `expect(JSON.stringify(report)).not.toMatch(/SYNTHETIC PRIVATE NAME|@example\\.test/u)`. There is no assertion on `page.content()` or the readout text.","impact":"The brief says \"no PII in DTO\", which is met. A future leak through the page's bundled props or the readout would not be caught by this test.","recommended_fix":"Add a check that the page text or HTML (`page.content()`) also does not contain the sentinels. Optionally assert an exact key allowlist on `report.leads` rows.","required_test":"After rendering the readout, assert that neither `page.content()` nor the readout text matches the PII sentinels.","confidence":0.4},{"severity":"NIT","file":".ai-team/reports/wp14-ab-browser.config.ts","area":"`webServer: { ...server, ... }`","issue":"The spread inherits any `reuseExistingServer` setting from the base config. The comment says \"reuse local dev server\", but this task should always start its own server against the disposable DB.","evidence":"The base `server` spread is not overridden for `reuseExistingServer`. The port is random, so the risk is small, but a race could attach to a stale server pointing at another database.","impact":"Low. If an unrelated server were reused, the test would run against the wrong database.","recommended_fix":"Set `reuseExistingServer: false` explicitly in the task-local config.","required_test":"Confirm that the resolved config has `reuseExistingServer === false`.","confidence":0.3},{"severity":"NIT","file":"tests/e2e/wp14-ab-readout.spec.ts","area":"Cleanup and side effects (the screenshot path and the missing teardown)","issue":"The spec creates two vendors and a funnel without cleanup, and writes screenshots into `docs/ai-team/evidence/...` on every run. This is acceptable only if the spec runs through the disposable-DB runner. If someone runs it directly against any local database that passes `assertLocalTestDatabase`, the data persists and the repo files change.","evidence":"There is no `afterAll` deletion, only `db.$disconnect()`. `readout.screenshot({ path: 'docs/ai-team/evidence/...' })` is unconditional.","impact":"Low. It leaves synthetic data in a local database and modifies the working tree when run outside the runner.","recommended_fix":"Document that the spec must run through the runner. Optionally gate the screenshot path on an env flag set only by the runner.","required_test":"None required beyond documenting the run path.","confidence":0.3}]}
